name: Metric Tracking & Hazard Zones
purpose: Track people and machinery in metric space, decide zone entry / continued presence / exit, and evaluate dynamic exclusion envelopes into a debounced collision risk. This is the deterministic safety core that turns observations into a decision.

public_interfaces.name: MetricKalmanFilter / MetricTrack
public_interfaces.contract: Constant-velocity EKF over metric ground coordinates; stable track identity across frames, explicit coast/expiry behaviour.

public_interfaces.name: ZoneOccupancyTracker transitions
public_interfaces.contract: Emits ENTRY / PRESENT / EXIT transitions with hysteresis; never emits a duplicate ENTRY for a continuously present agent.

public_interfaces.name: DynamicConflictEngine.evaluate
public_interfaces.contract: Evaluates worker/machinery pairs against active exclusion envelopes, returns pair risk with min TTC and collision probability, debounced before alerting.

acceptance_criteria: A synthetic crossing worker/machinery pair produces a DANGER evaluation before the closest approach.
A worker standing still inside a zone produces exactly one ENTRY and one EXIT.
Debouncing suppresses alert flapping across a single-frame boundary jitter.
Risk levels and business states are taken from event-contracts, not redefined locally.
risks: The tracker and conflict engine currently live inside the flat src/edge package together with runtime/forecast code; the physical split needs a package rename (see MIGRATION_PLAN.md).
Safety thresholds are configuration-driven; a wrong shift manifest silently changes what counts as danger.
